title: Study of the Safety, Tolerability and Immune Response of TBE Vaccines Administered to Healthy Children
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety, immunogenicity and tolerability of TBE vaccines administered to children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy male and female children, 1 to 10 years of age.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects with documented evidence of TBE
* Subjects, who have been previously vaccinated against TBE
